title: Murderer of Miracles
overview: A space shuttle sent to the Moon has recovered parts of heretical technology as well as the body of Dr. Nastassja, but a collision with space debris threatens to send it crashing into a mountain. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to use their songs to stop the collision in time?

title: Before I Destroy the World
overview: A mysterious enemy has struck simultaneously in Japan and London, where Tsubasa is performing a concert. Their power is even greater than that of the Symphogears, and they want to destroy the entire world.

title: Twilight of the Wielders
overview: The Autoscorers destroy two of the Symphogears, disabling the team. Now only Hibiki is left, and she's refusing to fight.

title: Gungnir, Once More
overview: With most of the Symphogears destroyed, it's up to Hibiki to fight the Autoscorers. But she's scared of hurting someone, and can't sing. Will she be able to find the will to fight?

title: Edge Works
overview: Almost every Symphogear wielder's gear is destroyed, and it seems there's no one left who can fight back. Elfnein has a plan, but before it can be carried out the Autoscorers attack S.O.N.G headquarters! It's up to Kirika and Shirabe to save the day, and they can barely transform...

title: Drawn Blade
overview: The Autoscorers are attacking SONG headquarters, and there are no function Symphogears left to stop them. Kirika and Shirabe have been defeated, and Tsubasa and Chris have only one chance left: to use the new Ignite Module system and hope they can retain control.

title: Carry On the Shining Light, and Stay True to Yourself
overview: Everyone decides to go to beach for "training". While they're having a good time, the Autoscorers attack, and Maria is forced to fight them despite her weakened state.

title: The Courage to Face It
overview: Hibiki is badly shaken up after her meeting with her father. She's so shaken up that even during the Autoscorer fight she can't focus properly, and Kirika and Shirabe have to protect her.

title: The Middle of a Dream
overview: The Autoscorers' goal is revealed, and the Symphogear wielders must split up to stop them. Tsubasa visits her dad's house, while Hibiki is still uncertain about her own father.

title: It's So Cruel, But...
overview: Dr. Ver is back, and the truth behind Carol's plot is revealed. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to stop them in time?

title: It's All Right. Everything Is Just Fine
overview: Carol's World Destructor device is complete, and she's ready to dissect the world. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to stop her in time?

title: GX
overview: Maria, Shirabe, and Kirika infiltrate the Château de Tiffauges to stop the world from disintegrating.

title: Believe in Justice, and Hold It Close
overview: Carol now has the power of 7 billion Superb Songs. Will the Symphogears be able to stop her with their new S2CA-Hexa Burst?
